target.quote: licensgebyret hævet til 150,- jf., hvad der blev vedtaget på repræsentantskabsmødet 2009

reason: The 2010 budget says the licence fee was raised to 150 kr. as decided in 2009, but the only fee decision of the 2009 meeting raised the start fee from 100 to 150 kr., no document shows a licence fee of 150 kr., and in 2024 the board writes that the licence fee had been the same for over 20 years.

Licensgebyret har været de samme i over 20 år
